items: Auzaar istemal: software kaamon mein madad deta hai, jaise group project ke data ke liye spreadsheet.
Maharaton ka mel: machine ki salahiyat aur insani faisla behtar nataij dete hain, jaise data analysis tools pecheeda data samjhate aur insaan faisle karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Online mil kar masail hal karne ki ahmiyat aur insaan aur machine ke tawun ka faida bataiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Digital auzaar mukhtalif jagahon ke logon ko maharatein jama karne aur ek saath ek hi files par kaam karne dete hain, to masail jaldi aur zyada khayalat ke saath hal hote hain. Insaan aur machine ka tawun computer ki raftar aur durustagi ko insani faisle aur takhleeqi salahiyat se jorta hai: spreadsheet ya data tool hazaron survey jawabon ko jama aur chart kar sakta, jabke students tay karte hain ke nataij ka matlab kya aur ab kya karna; tarjume ya grammar ke tools team ko wazeh likhne mein madad dete, jabke log maani jaanchte hain. Machine dohrane wala kaam aur insaan faisle karte hain.

items: Insaan aur machine ka tawun: raftar aur durustagi ke liye auzaar, faisle ke liye insaan.
